input.free_text_description: The system operates in the authentication, user management domain. It serves API Consumer, Admin, User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include ad dao, ad save form2 ad converter, ad service. Core business data revolves around AdSiteDao, AuthAdminDao, AuthPermissionDao, AuthPermissionRuleDao. The system enforces access control and identity verification for protected operations.

user_stories.story: As a API Consumer, I want to register and authenticate, so that I can securely access my account and protected resources.
As a API Consumer, I want to log into the system, so that I can access my personalized dashboard and features.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage ad dao operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage ad save form2 ad converter operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage ad service operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
